question_text: Was the Algonquin Dam on the Fox River hacked?
answer_text: Illinois DNR calls it an “apparent cyberattack”, an attempt at unauthorized access that staff blocked, and says the dam kept running. It has given no technical detail, so the attack itself is not independently shown.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: IDNR, the state police or CISA publishing findings that confirm or rule out an intrusion.

question_text: Did the dam's operations or safety suffer?
answer_text: IDNR says the dam stayed secure and fully operational. No source reports any effect on river levels or public safety.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: An IDNR or CISA statement giving the scope of what was reached, if anything.

question_text: Is this connected to the nationwide outages of recent weeks?
answer_text: IDNR says it has no indication of a link. No source shows one. That is not proof either way.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An investigators' finding tying it to, or separating it from, the other incidents.

answer_text: Nobody has said. Officials gave no details on the source or method.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An official attribution, a technical report or a credible claim of responsibility.

question_text: What will investigators publish, and when?
what_would_settle_it: A post-incident statement from IDNR, Illinois State Police, Illinois DoIT or CISA.
